svg.title: Olive Mountain — historical copperplate panorama, V4.2
svg.desc: Editorially composed native vector panorama: Walter Crane's documented public-domain original olive branch retained as paths at left, and a new line-engraved study of the slopes, terraces, Kidron valley and distant Jerusalem skyline at right. Composition studied against Woodward and Cousen 1881–1884; this is NOT a tracing or vectorization of their steel engraving. Designed exclusively for the visible reserved band outside the twelve speaker posters.
svg.metadata: Historic plant paths: Walter Crane, Line and Form (1900, 1914 reprint), Openclipart 7331, from repository master V13. Original ornamental engraving and architecture: Westside Watch V4.2 study, 2026-11-06. Woodward and Cousen, Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives (1881–1884), NYPL ID 80257, used only for scene composition reference. White alpha shapes are colored with existing Design OS gold via CSS mask. No raster images, scripts, gradients, fonts or animation.
